        })

    end

    createMySongsTile = function(layoutOrder)
        local m = getSpotifyMetrics()
        local cardH = m.compact and 228 or 242
        local coverPad = m.compact and 9 or 11
        local availableW = math.max(0, SongList.AbsoluteSize.X - ((m.gridColumns - 1) * m.gridGapX) - 8)
        local cellW = math.max(90, math.floor(availableW / m.gridColumns))
        local coverSize = math.floor(math.min(math.max(76, cellW - 20), m.compact and 138 or 182))

        local Card = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = SongList,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(coverSize + 20), cardH),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 43, 36),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            LayoutOrder = layoutOrder or 2,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            ZIndex = 12,
        })
        Card.Name = "SpotifyMySongsTile"
        corner(Card, 16)
        local CardStroke = mk("UIStroke", {
            Parent = Card,
            Color
 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 235, 165),
            Thickness = 1.35,
            Transparency = 0.18,
        })
        local CardStrokeGradient = mk("UIGradient", {
            Parent = CardStroke,
            Rotation = 0,
            Color = ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(42, 145, 92)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(190, 255, 218)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(42, 145, 92)),
            }),
        })
        TweenService:Create(CardStrokeGradient, TweenInfo.new(5, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1), {Rotation = 360}):Play()
        local CardScale = mk("UIScale", {Parent = Card, Scale = 1})
        local CardGradient = mk("UIGradient", {
            Parent = Card,
            Rotation = 135,
            Color = ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(26, 94, 67)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, Color3.fromRGB(18, 48, 39)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(15, 22, 25)),
            }),
        })

        local Glow = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = Card,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = spotifyGreen,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.82,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 12,
        })
        corner(Glow, 16)

        mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = Card,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(coverSize * 0.5), math.floor(coverSize * 0.5)),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -math.floor(coverSize * 0.25), 0, coverPad + math.floor(coverSize * 0.16)),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = asset(134397426600888),
            ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
            ZIndex = 14,
        })

        mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = Card,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, 22),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 11, 1, -48),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = GetText("Mis canciones", "My songs"),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            TextSize = m.compact and 13 or 15,
            TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = 14,
        })
        local mySongsTitle = Card:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
        if mySongsTitle then
            mySongsTitle:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", "Mis canciones")
            mySongsTitle:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", "My songs")
        end

        local countLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = Card,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, 16),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 11, 1, -27),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = GetText(tostring(#SpotifyState.UserSongs) .. " canciones propias", tostring(#SpotifyState.UserSongs) .. " personal songs"),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextSize = 9,
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 235, 215),
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = 14,
        })
        countLabel.Name = "MySongsCount"
        countLabel:SetAttribute("MySongsCountLabel", true)
        countLabel:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", tostring(#SpotifyState.UserSongs) .. " canciones propias")
        countLabel:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", tostring(#SpotifyState.UserSongs) .. " personal songs")

        bindRowTap(Card, function()
            SpotifyState.FavoritesView = false
            SpotifyState.MySongsView = true
            SongList.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
            SongSearchBox.Text = ""
            refreshSpotifyCatalogMode()
        end)
        Card.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(Card, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 78, 58)
            }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(CardScale, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1.025}):Play()
        end)
        Card.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(Card, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 43, 36)
            }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(CardScale, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
        end)
        return Card
    end

    FavPage.HEART_ON = asset(116559368303288)
    FavPage.HEART_OFF = asset(116559368303288)
    FavPage.PLAY = asset(135609604299893)
    FavPage.PAUSE = asset(74873705394436)
    FavPage.SEARCH = asset(121018724060431)
    FavPage.HERO_H = 196
    FavPage.covers = {}
    FavPage.rows = {}
    FavPage.history = {}
    FavPage.signature = nil
    FavPage.open = false
    FavPage.query = ""

    FavPage.text = function(label, es, en)
        label:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", es)
        label:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", en)
        label.Text = GetText(es, en)
    end

    FavPage.tween = function(obj, t, props)
        TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(t, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props):Play()
    end

    FavPage.likedList = function()
        local list = {}
        for i = 1, #SpotifyState.Catalog do
            if isLiked(i) then
                list[#list + 1] = i
            end
        end
        return list
    end

    FavPage.randomFrom = function(list, exclude)
        if #list == 0 then
            return nil
        end
        if #list == 1 then
            return list[1]
        end
        local pick = exclude
        local guard = 0
        while pick == exclude and guard < 20 do
            pick = list[math.random(1, #list)]
            guard = guard + 1
        end
        return pick
    end

    FavPage.neighbor = function(fromIndex, dir)
        local list
        if SpotifyState.FavQueue then
            list = FavPage.likedList()
        elseif SpotifyState.Shuffle then
            list = {}
            for i = 1, #SpotifyState.Catalog do
                list[i] = i
            end
        else
            return nil
        end
        if #list == 0 then
            return nil
        end
        if SpotifyState.Shuffle then
            if dir < 0 then
                local back = table.remove(FavPage.history)
                if back and SpotifyState.Catalog[back] then
                    return back
                end
            else
                FavPage.remember(fromIndex)
            end
            return FavPage.randomFrom(list, fromIndex)
        end
        local pos = nil
        for p, idx in ipairs(list) do
            if idx == fromIndex then
                pos = p
                break
            end
        end
        if not pos then
            return list[dir > 0 and 1 or #list]
        end
        pos = pos + dir
        if pos > #list then pos = 1 end
        if pos < 1 then pos = #list end
        return list[pos]
    end

    FavPage.remember = function(index)
        if index and SpotifyState.Catalog[index] then
            table.insert(FavPage.history, index)
            if #FavPage.history > 50 then
                table.remove(FavPage.history, 1)
            end
        end
    end

    FavPage.play = function(index)
        if SpotifyState.CurrentTrack and SpotifyState.SelectedIndex ~= index then
            FavPage.remember(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex)
        end
        SpotifyState.FavQueue = true
        playTrack(index)
    end

    FavPage.totalText = function(list)
        local seconds = 0
        for _, index in ipairs(list) do
            local song = SpotifyState.Catalog[index]
            if song then
                seconds = seconds + durationToSeconds(song.Duration)
            end
        end
        local minutes = math.max(1, math.floor(seconds / 60 + 0.5))
        if minutes >= 60 then
            local h, m = math.floor(minutes / 60), minutes % 60
            return string.format("%d h %d min", h, m), string.format("%d hr %d min", h, m)
        end
        return string.format("%d min", minutes), string.format("%d min", minutes)
    end

        Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0.5, -16),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Text = "‹",
        TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
        TextSize = 26,
        AutoButtonColor = false,
        ZIndex = 52,
    })
    corner(FavPage.Back, 999)
    FavPage.MiniPlay = mk("TextButton", {
        Parent = FavPage.TopBar,
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 54, 0.5, -17),
        BackgroundColor3 = spotifyGreen,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Text = "",
        AutoButtonColor = false,
        Visible = false,
        ZIndex = 52,
    })
    corner(FavPage.MiniPlay, 999)
    FavPage.MiniIcon = mk("ImageLabel", {
        Parent = FavPage.MiniPlay,
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 15),
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Image = FavPage.PLAY,
        ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
        ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
        ZIndex = 53,
    })
    FavPage.MiniTitle = mk("TextLabel", {
        Parent = FavPage.TopBar,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 1, 0),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 98, 0, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "",
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextSize = 17,
        TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        Visible = false,
        ZIndex = 52,
    })
    FavPage.text(FavPage.MiniTitle, "Canciones que te gustan", "Liked Songs")

    FavPage.layout = function()
        local w = FavPage.Root.AbsoluteSize.X
        if w <= 0 then
            return
        end
        local narrow = w < 520
        local cover = narrow and 104 or 136
        FavPage.Cover.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cover, cover)
        FavPage.Info.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20 + cover + 16, 1, -18)
        FavPage.Info.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(20 + cover + 16 + 16), 0, cover)
        FavPage.Title.TextSize = narrow and 22 or (w < 760 and 30 or 38)
        FavPage.Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.max(40, cover - 64))
        FavPage.Kind.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, narrow and 2 or 14)
        FavPage.SearchBox.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(narrow and 140 or 210, 32)
        FavPage.HeadTime.Visible = not narrow
    end
    FavPage.Root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(FavPage.layout)

    FavPage.Scroll:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(function()
        local y = FavPage.Scroll.CanvasPosition.Y
        local solid = y > FavPage.HERO_H - 40
        FavPage.TopBar.BackgroundTransparency = solid and 0 or math.clamp(1 - (y / (FavPage.HERO_H - 40)), 0, 1)
        FavPage.MiniPlay.Visible = solid and FavPage.PlayAll.Visible
        FavPage.MiniTitle.Visible = solid
    end)

    FavPage.isCurrent = function(index)
        return SpotifyState.CurrentTrack ~= nil and SpotifyState.SelectedIndex == index
    end

    FavPage.paintRow = function(row)
        local current = FavPage.isCurrent(row.Index)
        local playing = current and SpotifyState.IsPlaying and SpotifyState.CurrentSound ~= nil
        row.Title.TextColor3 = current and spotifyGreen or spotifyText
        row.Number.TextColor3 = current and spotifyGreen or Color3.fromRGB(179, 179, 179)
        row.Number.Visible = not playing and not row.Hover
        row.Bars.Visible = playing and not row.Hover
        row.HoverIcon.Visible = row.Hover == true
        row.HoverIcon.Image = playing and FavPage.PAUSE or FavPage.PLAY
    end

    FavPage.paint = function()
        for _, row in ipairs(FavPage.rows) do
            FavPage.paintRow(row)
        end
        local playingFav = SpotifyState.CurrentSound ~= nil and SpotifyState.IsPlaying and isLiked(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex)
        FavPage.PlayIcon.Image = playingFav and FavPage.PAUSE or FavPage.PLAY
        FavPage.MiniIcon.Image = FavPage.PlayIcon.Image
        local shuffle = SpotifyState.Shuffle == true
        FavPage.ShuffleBtn.TextColor3 = shuffle and spotifyGreen or Color3.fromRGB(179, 179, 179)
        FavPage.ShuffleDot.Visible = shuffle
    end

    FavPage.toggleRow = function(index)
        if FavPage.isCurrent(index) and SpotifyState.CurrentSound then
            SpotifyState.FavQueue = true
            togglePlayback()
        else
            FavPage.play(index)
        end
    end

    FavPage.makeRow = function(index, position)
        local song = SpotifyState.Catalog[index]
        if not song then
            return
        end
        local Row = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = FavPage.Body,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            LayoutOrder = position,
            ZIndex = 42,
        })
        corner(Row, 6)

        local Number = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = Row,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 58),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = tostring(position),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextSize = 14,
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(179, 179, 179),
            ZIndex = 43,
        })
        local HoverIcon = mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = Row,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 17, 0.5, -7),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = FavPage.PLAY,
            ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
            Visible = false,
            ZIndex = 43,
        })
        local Bars = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = Row,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 17, 0.5, -7),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Visible = false,
            ZIndex = 43,
        })
        local bars = {}
        for b = 1, 3 do
            local bar = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Bars,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, 0),
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, (b - 1) * 5, 1, 0),
                BackgroundColor3 = spotifyGreen,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ZIndex = 44,
            })
            bars[b] = bar
        end

        local Cover = mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = Row,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 42),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 48, 0.5, -21),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Image = FavPage.covers[index] or "",
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
            ZIndex = 43,
        })
        corner(Cover, 4)
        if not FavPage.covers[index] then
            task.spawn(function()
                local ok, img = pcall(resolveTrackCoverImage, song)
                if ok and type(img) == "string" and img ~= "" then
                    FavPage.covers[index] = img
                    if Cover.Parent then
                        Cover.Image = img
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        local Title = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = Row,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -230, 0, 20),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 102, 0, 10),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = song.Name,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextSize = 15,
            TextColor3 = spotifyText,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = 43,
        })
        mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = Row,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -230, 0, 16),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 102, 0, 31),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = song.Artist,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextSize = 13,
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(179, 179, 179),
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = 43,
        })
        local Heart = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = Row,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -126, 0.5, -18),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            ZIndex = 45,
        })
        mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = Heart,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = FavPage.HEART_ON,
            ImageColor3 = spotifyGreen,
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
            ZIndex = 46,
        })
        mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = Row,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 58),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -78, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = song.Duration,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextSize = 13,
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(179, 179, 179),
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
            ZIndex = 43,
        })

        local row = {Index = index, Row = Row, Title = Title, Number = Number, Bars = Bars, BarList = bars, HoverIcon = HoverIcon, Heart = Heart}
        FavPage.rows[#FavPage.rows + 1] = row
        Row.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            row.Hover = true
            Row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9
            FavPage.paintRow(row)
        end)
        Row.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            row.Hover = false
            Row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            FavPage.paintRow(row)
        end)
        FavPage.paintRow(row)

        bindRowTap(Heart, function()
            toggleTrackLike(index)
        end)
        bindRowTap(Row, function()
            FavPage.toggleRow(index)
        end)
    end

    FavPage.rebuild = function()
        for _, child in ipairs(FavPage.Body:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
                safeDestroy(child)
            end
        end
        FavPage.rows = {}
        local list = FavPage.likedList()
        local query = normalizeSearchText(FavPage.query or "")
        local shown = 0
        for position, index in ipairs(list) do
            local song = SpotifyState.Catalog[index]
            local ok = query == ""
            if not ok and song then
                ok = normalizeSearchText((song.Name or "") .. " " .. (song.Artist or "")):find(query, 1, true) ~= nil
            end
            if ok then
                shown = shown + 1
                FavPage.makeRow(index, position)
            end
        end
        if #list == 0 or shown == 0 then
            local box = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = FavPage.Body,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 170),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                LayoutOrder = 1,
                ZIndex = 42,
            })
            mk("ImageLabel", {
                Parent = box,
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 44),
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
                Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 24),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Image = #list == 0 and FavPage.HEART_OFF or FavPage.SEARCH,
                ImageColor3 = spotifyDim,
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                ZIndex = 43,
            })
            local t1 = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = box,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 80),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = "",
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
                TextSize = 18,
                TextColor3 = spotifyText,
                ZIndex = 43,
            })
            local t2 = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = box,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 40),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 110),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = "",
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
                TextSize = 13,
                TextWrapped = true,
                TextColor3 = spotifyDim,
                ZIndex = 43,
            })
            if #list == 0 then
                FavPage.text(t1, "Las canciones que te gusten aparecerán acá", "Songs you like will appear here")
                FavPage.text(t2, "Tocá el corazón de cualquier canción para guardarla.", "Save songs by tapping the heart icon.")
            else
                FavPage.text(t1, "No se encontraron resultados", "No results found")
                FavPage.text(t2, "Probá con otro nombre o artista.", "Try another name or artist.")
            end
        end
        FavPage.PlayAll.Visible = #list > 0
        FavPage.ShuffleBtn.Visible = #list > 0
        local es = (#list == 1) and "1 canción" or (tostring(#list) .. " canciones")
        local en = (#list == 1) and "1 song" or (tostring(#list) .. " songs")
        if #list > 0 then
            local tes, ten = FavPage.totalText(list)
            es = es .. ", aprox. " .. tes
            en = en .. ", about " .. ten
        end
        FavPage.text(FavPage.Count, "• " .. es, "• " .. en)
        FavPage.signature = table.concat(list, ",") .. "|" .. query
        FavPage.paint()
    end

    FavPage.refresh = function()
        if not FavPage.open then
            return
        end
        local sig = table.concat(FavPage.likedList(), ",") .. "|" .. normalizeSearchText(FavPage.query or "")
        if sig ~= FavPage.signature then
            FavPage.rebuild()
        else
            FavPage.paint()
        end
    end

    FavPage.SearchInput:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
        FavPage.query = FavPage.SearchInput.Text or ""
        FavPage.refresh()
    end)

    FavPage.animate = function()
        task.spawn(function()
            while FavPage.open and FavPage.Root.Parent do
                if SpotifyState.IsPlaying then
                    for _, row in ipairs(FavPage.rows) do
                        if row.Bars.Visible then
                            for _, bar in ipairs(row.BarList) do
                                FavPage.tween(bar, 0.18, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, math.random(25, 100) / 100, 0)})
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                task.wait(0.2)
            end
        end)
    end

    FavPage.show = function()
        if FavPage.open then
            return
        end
        FavPage.open = true
        FavPage.layout()
        FavPage.rebuild()
        FavPage.Scroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
        FavPage.Root.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
        FavPage.Root.Visible = true
        TweenService:Create(FavPage.Root, TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)}):Play()
        task.defer(FavPage.layout)
        FavPage.animate()
    end

    FavPage.hide = function()
        if not FavPage.open then
            return
        end
        FavPage.open = false
        pcall(function() FavPage.SearchInput:ReleaseFocus() end)
        local tw = TweenService:Create(FavPage.Root, TweenInfo.new(0.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)})
        tw.Completed:Connect(function()
            if not FavPage.open then
                FavPage.Root.Visible = false
            end
        end)
        tw:Play()
    end

    FavPage.playAll = function()
        local list = FavPage.likedList()
        if #list == 0 then
            return
        end
        if SpotifyState.CurrentSound and isLiked(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex) then
            SpotifyState.FavQueue = true
            togglePlayback()
        elseif SpotifyState.Shuffle then
            FavPage.play(FavPage.randomFrom(list, nil))
        else
            FavPage.play(list[1])
        end
    end

    bindRowTap(FavPage.Back, FavPage.hide)
    bindRowTap(FavPage.PlayAll, FavPage.playAll)
    bindRowTap(FavPage.MiniPlay, FavPage.playAll)
    bindRowTap(FavPage.ShuffleBtn, function()
        SpotifyState.Shuffle = not SpotifyState.Shuffle
        FavPage.history = {}
        FavPage.paint()
    end)

    SpotifyState.OnPlaybackChanged = FavPage.refresh
    SpotifyState.FavoriteNeighbor = FavPage.neighbor

    createSongRow = function(track, index, layoutOrder)
        if SpotifyState.HiddenRows[index] then
            return
        end

        local m = getSpotifyMetrics()
        local cardH = m.compact and 228 or 242
        local coverPad = m.compact and 9 or 11
        local availableW = math.max(0, SongList.AbsoluteSize.X - ((m.gridColumns - 1) * m.gridGapX) - 8)
        local cellW = math.max(90, math.floor(availableW / m.gridColumns))
        local coverSize = math.max(76, cellW - 20)
        coverSize = math.floor(math.min(coverSize, m.compact and 138 or 182))

        local Row = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = SongList,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(coverSize + 20), cardH),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 24),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            LayoutOrder = layoutOrder or (index + 1),
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            ZIndex = 11,
        })
        Row.Name = "SpotifySongCard_" .. index
        corner(Row, 12)

        local TapArea = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = Row, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 13,
        })
        TapArea.Name = "SongTapArea"

        local Accent = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = Row, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = spotifyGreen, BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Visible = index == SpotifyState.SelectedIndex, ZIndex = 14,
        })
        corner(Accent, 999)

        local Cover = mk("ImageButton", {
            Parent = Row, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(coverSize, coverSize),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -(coverSize / 2), 0, coverPad),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 0,
            BorderSizePixel = 0, Image = resolveTrackCoverImage(track),
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 15,
        })
        corner(Cover, 9)

        local Title = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = Row, Size = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, 20),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 11, 0, coverPad + coverSize + 9),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = track.Name, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            TextSize = m.compact and 12 or 14, TextColor3 = index == SpotifyState.SelectedIndex and spotifyGreen or spotifyText,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextWrapped = true, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, ZIndex = 16,
        })
        Title.Name = "SongTitle"

        local Artist = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = Row, Size = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, 16),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 11, 0, coverPad + coverSize + 31),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = track.Artist, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextSize = m.compact and 9 or 10, TextColor3 = index == SpotifyState.SelectedIndex and Color3.fromRGB(100, 220, 120) or spotifyDim,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 12,
        })
        Artist.Name = "SongArtist"

        local Duration = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = Row, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 16), Position = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, -22),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = track.Duration, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextSize = 9,
            TextColor3 = spotifyDim, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, ZIndex = 12,
        })
        Duration.Name = "SongDuration"

        loca
